title: Tech Note: 4D Internet Commands - Net Commands

historical_commentary.text: Based on the available teaser, this note expands an earlier ping utility (TN 00-43) with DNS/reverse-DNS lookup and finger-command support, built on the 4D Internet Commands plug-in, aimed at helping developers diagnose network issues while deploying 4D applications. The 4D Internet Commands plug-in's low-level networking utilities have since been superseded by native language commands and modern diagnostic tooling, and the UNIX finger protocol itself has been almost universally disabled/deprecated across the internet for decades on security grounds, making this specific utility historical rather than practically useful today.
related_updates: The finger protocol has been widely deprecated/disabled across networks for security reasons since the late 1990s/2000s

4D's networking/diagnostic capabilities have since been incorporated more directly into the core language and modern OS-level tools, reducing reliance on the original 4D Internet Commands plug-in utilities
